tooltip.minepc.perf_cooler: Keeps boost on CPUs up to %s, base clock up to %s
param.minepc.cpu.socket.help: CPU socket. The board must have the same socket.
param.minepc.cpu.cores.help: How many programs run at once without slowing down. More cores don't speed up a single program.
param.minepc.cpu.clock.help: Speed of one program: 1 MHz is a million Lua instructions per second. Higher means more heat.
param.minepc.cpu.process.help: A finer process makes less heat per MHz and a stronger boost while the CPU is cool.
param.minepc.cpu.cache.help: Fast memory inside the CPU. More cache means the CPU needs less RAM bandwidth.
param.minepc.cpu.igpu.help: Integrated graphics drive the screen without a graphics card. Takes some RAM and adds heat. Disabled when a card is installed.
param.minepc.cpu.lid.help: Looks only. The flagship lid unlocks a glowing logo.
param.minepc.mobo.socket.help: Which CPU fits: the board and CPU sockets must match.
param.minepc.mobo.chipset.help: The highest CPU tier the board supports: basic — T1 … flagship — T5.
param.minepc.mobo.channels.help: How many sticks work in parallel. Bandwidth adds up per channel.
param.minepc.mobo.ram_speed.help: The fastest RAM the board allows. Faster sticks run at this speed.
param.minepc.mobo.sata.help: Ports for hard drives and SATA SSDs.
param.minepc.cooler.type.help: Cooler design. Together with heat pipes and fans it sets how much heat it removes.
param.minepc.cooler.pipes.help: More heat pipes remove more heat.
param.minepc.cooler.fans.help: A second fan on a tower adds 15% cooling.
param.minepc.cooler.radiator.help: Liquid cooler radiator length: longer removes more heat.
param.minepc.ram.chips.help: Chips per stick. Stick size = chips × chip size.
param.minepc.ram.chip_mb.help: Size of one chip. All of the stick's memory goes to programs.
param.minepc.ram.speed.help: How much data the stick moves per second. The CPU needs what its "Memory needed" says, or it waits for memory.
param.minepc.ram.heatsink.help: Looks only. A heatsink allows lighting.
param.minepc.gpu.chip.help: VX graphics chip: higher models have more units, draw faster and support larger screens.
param.minepc.gpu.clock.help: Chip clock: drawing speed rises with it, and so does heat.
param.minepc.gpu.vram_chips.help: Video memory chips. More chips mean a wider bus and more memory for screens.
param.minepc.gpu.vram_chip_mb.help: Size of one video memory chip. Video memory sets how many screens (frame buffers) fit.
param.minepc.gpu.vram_type.help: Video memory speed. Slow memory can't keep up with a strong chip.
param.minepc.gpu.cooler.help: How much heat the cooling removes. If the chip makes more, the card lowers its clock.
param.minepc.gpu.thickness.help: A thicker shroud means a bigger heatsink: +20% or +40% cooling on 2–3 fan models.
param.minepc.psu.wattage.help: How much power the unit gives to parts. If the build needs more, the computer won't start.
param.minepc.psu.cert.help: Efficiency: how much wall power reaches the parts. The rest becomes heat.
param.minepc.psu.side.help: Looks only. A window side shows the lighting.
param.minepc.hdd.form.help: 2.5" is small and cool, 3.5" is bigger and draws more power.
param.minepc.hdd.capacity.help: How many files fit on the drive.
param.minepc.hdd.rpm.help: Spindle speed: sets read speed and system boot time.
param.minepc.hdd.cache.help: Drive buffer: speeds reading up a little.
param.minepc.ssd.iface.help: SSD interface: SATA uses SATA ports, NVMe uses M.2 slots and is much faster.
param.minepc.ssd.capacity.help: How many files fit on the SSD.
param.minepc.ssd.nand.help: Memory type: QLC is slower, SLC is the fastest.
gui.minepc.help_general: Click an option to pick it. Shift + wheel over a parameter cycles options. Hover a parameter name to see what it does. Preview: drag to rotate, wheel to zoom, RMB to reset.

param.minepc.cpu.srv_cores.help: Server CPU cores. A server board takes two identical CPUs, and their cores add up. The server setting maxCores caps how many actually run at once.
param.minepc.mobo.form.help: Server board: two MS-S sockets, 8–16 ECC-only memory slots, 4–8 channels, two 10 Gbit/s network ports. Fits only a server chassis: a rack module or a server case.
param.minepc.mobo.srv_channels.help: How many sticks work in parallel. A server with dozens of cores needs many channels, or the cores wait for memory.
param.minepc.ram.ecc.help: ECC is server memory: a ninth chip per eight stores check bits. It fits only server boards, and regular memory doesn't fit a server board.
